stage_2_story.text_en: On a warm Friday evening, Yossi and his teenage daughter drove to an open-air concert in the park. The band had just released a new album, and this was their first live show in two years. They found a good spot on the grass and spread out a blanket. When the singer stepped onto the stage, the crowd cheered loudly. The beat of the drums kicked in first, followed by a gentle melody from the guitar. Yossi did not know all the lyrics, but his daughter sang every single word. Between songs, she explained what each track was about — some were sad, some were funny. By the end of the night, even Yossi found himself tapping his foot to the rhythm. On the drive home, a familiar tune came on the radio. 'That's from their old album,' his daughter said, smiling. Yossi turned up the volume.
